scenarios.name: Conflicting Audit Evidence
scenarios.context: Two independent auditors assess same entity. A finds compliance, B finds violations.
scenarios.distinction: Binary hides conflict. Algebra: l=0.085, v=0.810, u=0.105 reveals strong conflicting evidence. Response: investigate discrepancy, not coin flip.

scenarios.name: New Vendor (No History)
scenarios.context: New cloud vendor for PHI storage. No audit history, no breach history.
scenarios.binary: FAIL (both new vendor and known violator)
scenarios.distinction: Binary: both get FAIL. Algebra: vendor (l=0, v=0, u=1, P=0.5) vs violator (l=0, v=1, u=0, P=0.0). Vendor needs evidence gathering; violator needs blocking.

scenarios.name: BAA Chain (3 Organizations)
scenarios.binary: FAIL (any weak link fails entire chain)
scenarios.distinction: Binary: FAIL with no guidance. Algebra: l degrades 0.920 -> 0.587 (lab) -> 0.176 (billing). Billing link is primary risk driver (81% total degradation).

scenarios.name: Stale Assessment (2 Years Old)
scenarios.context: Strong assessment 2 years ago (l=0.90). No reassessment since.
scenarios.distinction: Binary: PASS forever. Algebra: l decays 0.900 -> 0.225 over 2 years, u grows 0.050 -> 0.762. Triggers reassessment when u exceeds threshold.

scenarios.name: Multinational Clinical Trial (HIPAA + GDPR)
scenarios.context: US hospital + EU partner. Strong HIPAA, uncertain GDPR.
scenarios.distinction: Binary: both FAIL. Algebra: uncertain dual (l=0.352, u=0.464) vs violation dual (l=0.044, v=0.904). Uncertain: proceed with monitoring. Violation: halt processing.
